entries.message: Crest has a fresh look: a new three-banner mark, warm paper surfaces, Crest blue for actions, and bold rounded headings across setup, Settings and the Start Page.
The app icon and each alternative icon now follow your system's light, dark, tinted and clear icon styles, and sit at the right size in the Dock.
New Simple crests (Crest, Moon, Summit, Lens, Spark and Grove) sit beside the Heraldic ones when you choose a Space's icon, and new Spaces start in the Crest look.
Setup opens on a full welcome, then lays its steps on a sheet of paper beside a live preview of Crest, with the steps as colored chips you can tap to go straight to one.
Setup now ends with Make It Home, where you can make Crest your default browser and choose its search and how much ad blocking blocks.
On iPhone, and on iPad held upright, setup walks the same steps as on a Mac: each Space's page wears that Space's colors, Preview shows it as Crest will, and the buttons float over the page.
Finishing setup now responds the moment you tap Start Browsing and moves into Crest in one smooth motion, without a pause, a flash or a late page.
A new window that opens on Getting Started or Settings shows it at once instead of after a blank pause.
The Space picker shows your Spaces in a well with a clear selector, a lighter mark for Sub-Spaces, and corners that follow your Corner radius setting.
Settings shows solid icons in Crest's colors.
Spaces brought in from another browser keep their own icon, set on a round crest in the Space's color.
Search engine icons in pickers are now sized to their name, with clear room between the two.
